mapper.select: SELECT CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) AS report_day, COUNT(*) AS orders, CAST(SUM(o.payment) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) amount FROM o_order o WHERE GROUP BY CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) ORDER BY report_day

SELECT CAST(o.order_time AS DATE) AS report_day, CAST(SUM(r.refund_fee) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS amount FROM o_refund r JOIN o_order o ON o.order_num=r.order_num AND o.shop_id=r.shop_id AND o.merchant_id=r.merchant_id WHERE AND r.status=4 AND r.refund_type IN (1,10,11) AND r.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY CAST(o.order_time AS DATE)

SELECT o.shop_id id, COALESCE(s.name,'未命名店铺') name, CAST(SUM(o.payment) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) amount, COUNT(*) quantity FROM o_order o LEFT JOIN o_shop s ON s.id=o.shop_id WHERE GROUP BY o.shop_id,s.name ORDER BY amount DESC,o.shop_id LIMIT 6

SELECT i.goods_id id, COALESCE(g.name,MAX(i.goods_title),'未命名商品') name, COALESCE(g.image,MAX(i.goods_img),'') image, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(i.payment,i.item_amount,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) amount, SUM(i.quantity) quantity FROM o_order_item i JOIN o_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN o_goods g ON g.id=i.goods_id WHERE GROUP BY i.goods_id,g.name,g.image ORDER BY amount DESC,i.goods_id LIMIT 5
SELECT o.order_status code,COUNT(*) value FROM o_order o WHERE GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY o.order_status

SELECT r.refund_type code,COUNT(*) value FROM o_refund r JOIN o_order o ON o.order_num=r.order_num AND o.shop_id=r.shop_id AND o.merchant_id=r.merchant_id WHERE AND r.status <> 1 AND r.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY r.refund_type ORDER BY r.refund_type

SELECT w.id,w.warehouse_name name,COALESCE(SUM(v.quantity),0) quantity, COALESCE(SUM(v.available_quantity),0) available,COALESCE(SUM(v.locked_quantity),0) locked, SUM(CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(v.available_quantity,0)<=COALESCE(s.low_qty,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lowStockCount FROM erp_warehouse w LEFT JOIN o_goods_inventory v ON v.warehouse_id=w.id AND COALESCE(v.is_delete,0)=0 AND v.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND v.shop_id=#{shopId} LEFT JOIN o_goods_sku s ON s.id=v.sku_id WHERE 1=1 AND w.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o_goods_inventory x WHERE x.warehouse_id=w.id AND x.shop_id=#{shopId} AND COALESCE(x.is_delete,0)=0) GROUP BY w.id,w.warehouse_name ORDER BY quantity DESC,w.id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o_order WHERE order_status=1 AND merchant_id=#{merchantId}AND shop_id=#{shopId}) waitShip, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_stock_in WHERE status IN (0,1) AND merchant_id=#{merchantId}AND shop_id=#{shopId}) waitInbound, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_stock_out WHERE status IN (0,1) AND merchant_id=#{merchantId}AND shop_id=#{shopId}) waitOutbound, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o_refund WHERE status NOT IN (1,4) AND merchant_id=#{merchantId}AND shop_id=#{shopId}) waitAfterSale
